subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Wedding invitations will be sent by them.

options.text: They will be sent wedding invitations.
He will be send wedding invitations.

solution:
The correct answer is "**They will send wedding invitations.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in passive voice, which means the subject is receiving the action.
 
 
• He is loved by his parents.
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject performs the action. 
 
 
• His parents love him.
 
 
 
• **To convert a passive sentence to active, we need to make the subject the doer of the action and the object the receiver.**
 
• **In this case, "they" will be the subject performing the action of sending wedding invitations.**
 
• Thus, the correct sentence in active voice will be: They will send wedding invitations.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.
